scope: Chapter 8A whole (regs 529A, 529B, 529C, 529CA to 529CE, 529D to 529F, 529G to 529J; the acknowledgements in 529G(4), 529H(2), 529I(3) are the regulator's and out), with what Chapter 8A sends the worker to: reg 50 (air monitoring and its 30-year record), Part 7.1 Division 6 (regs 368 to 378, health monitoring, for crystalline silica) and Schedule 14 table 14.1 item 7, reg 689A(2) (an exemption granted, as a fact), regs 698A (pre-2024 contracts), and the penalty tiers with Act Schedule 4 cl 2. Out: regs 689A(1), 689B to 689E (the regulator's exemption process), 698B (constitutional), the rest of the Regulations, the workplace exposure standard's value (a Safe Work Australia document, not deposited), State and Territory WHS laws, and compensation for silica disease (other Acts).
seat: the worker who manufactures, supplies, processes, installs, removes or works near crystalline silica substances or engineered stone for a business or undertaking the Commonwealth Act covers
